CL-3 P1 Post-Fan-Out Diff Verification Gate (Phase 4 step 3b + 15th regression gate row) adopted to prevent recurrence by auto-downgrading any claimed-done finding with zero-diff against claimed files.

Already-resolved detection gap: D16-M1 was targeted but the 4-tuple feature-status schema was already in AUDIT-EXECUTE.md:190 from Cycle 7.5 commit ca8c5a2 (Cycle 7 Phase 7 CL-3 P3). 1 sub-agent slot (~90K tokens) spent on a finding that should have been already_resolved at Phase 1 triage. CL-3 P2 Phase 1 Prior-Cycle Resolution Cross-Check (scan last 3 cycles' commits for keyword + file-reference matches before promoting) adopted.

Test-fixture lag on refactors: D12-M1 stdout/stderr routing broke 32 tests whose call-site spies only asserted console.log was called (the existing tests proved nothing about stream choice). CL-3 P5 Central-Path Classification (Phase 1 triage flags findings touching output/logging/error paths to require explicit test-fixture acceptance criteria) adopted.

Registry revert vulnerability: baseline.json + finding-registry.json Phase 0/1 updates were reverted once during this cycle (cause unclear — possibly file-watcher or concurrent sub-agent write collision). CL-3 P3 Registry Anchor Checksum (Invariant 6 with sha256 anchor rule + Workspace Lifecycle anchor log) adopted.

Compression discipline preserved: AUDIT-EXECUTE.md grew 627 → 641/700 after adding 10 CL-3 proposals. Execution Telemetry section compression freed ~23 lines; Regression Gates table tightened. No lean threshold breach. Per-file budgets: D09 79/80, D19 56 → 57/80, rigor-contract 98 → 117, reviewer-sub-agent 192 → 194.

Aggressive fan-out viability at Medium scale: 28 sub-agents (5 file-lock groups + 23 standalone) resolving 40 findings produced 87.5% success rate (35 done + 1 partial + 1 already_resolved of 40 targeted), slightly below Cycle 7.5 W2B2's 86.5% on 52 findings but with higher 7.5% rollback loss (vs 0% in W2B2). File-lock discipline on init.ts (6-finding group at hard ceiling) held cleanly; the failures were on shared-prefix files outside explicit file-lock groups.

Security net positive: 7 security-relevant findings landed (D4-M1 dependency-review-action, D11-M1 deny-pattern cascade, D15-M1 5 new P-PIPE-08..12 patterns, D15-M2 CWE-552 worktree warn, D15-M3 tool-policy hard error, D5-M2 injection-patterns canonical catalog, D2-M5 recursion depth cap 32). 0 credential-like strings in diffs; 0 new attack surface. D13-M1 rollback left pre-existing Finding #68 iteration-based confidence signal intact (no security regression).

Bundle growth +6.3% (479.82 → 513.87 KB ESM) outside ±5% soft threshold but explained: additive provenance module (src/models/provenance.ts + AdapterOutput.sourceFiles), 5 new injection patterns with test fixtures, canonical catalog at agents/shared/injection-patterns.md, new helpers. Not a block; growth is proportional to feature footprint.
